entries.note: DispatchTrack's snapshot stage code before the driver's route starts; the tracker's rail titles its first step so, or Order Received when the firm has not set a day.
The driver's route has started with a pickup before the drop; the tracker shows the order as out for delivery.
The driver is at the pickup before the drop; the tracker shows the order as out for delivery.
The driver is on the way to the drop.
The driver is at the drop; the tracker's rail leaves its delivery step open.
A finished stop; the snapshot's status label reads Finished.
The stop ended with part of the order delivered; the tracker's rail leaves its delivery step open.
